first_usable_bank.boundary: Bounded pre-full-R1 delivery; file/URL/note save/search/originals first, no new release version assigned.
first_usable_bank.next_step: Independent first-use integration card review/design, then bounded local implementation, guarded native apply and first-use proof.
mandatory_checks: Reconcile scoped current documentation with preserved history (P-1).
Explicit supported UTF-8 text file path and exact content-query/original bytes oracle (P-2).
External app/Commander save becomes visible in open UI automatically, with read-only change detection and honest snapshot/refresh states (U-3).
Visible durable failed/incomplete diagnostics across reopen, separately from canonical accepted receipts; exact retry/no duplicate; accepted truth never overwritten (U-3).

Usable launch/config/root setup and retained/reopened file/URL/note workflows; applicable access/privacy, recoverability and minimal safeguarding of real materials reviewed before actual Bank initialization (U-3).
Native bounded UI/command integration, fresh source identity, original bytes/history/ref/replay regression; symlink limitations explicitly resolved or not falsely accepted (U-1/U-2).
not_required_for_this_first_delivery: All four type/version editor UI (D-2 later, still required full R1).
General OCR/PDF extraction, semantic search, external AI provider integration, research or Watch.
Larger size policy or general durable background job framework.
first_usable_bank.setup_scope_guard: This review does not create/install/import a real Bank. Review concrete setup/paths and first-use acceptance before that separate step.

completed_documentation_checks.P-1: Scoped current ledger reconciled, native guarded apply/readback confirmed; preserve historical/current uncertainty boundaries.

after_first_use.next: R1_OBJECT_AUTHORING.json with all11 existing gates; then remaining R1 acceptance, not a waiver.

milestones.title: Контракты и граница MVP
milestones.scope: Intent parity, Source≠Entity, IDs/версии/эпистемические слои, минимальный validated local handoff и acceptance. UI ещё нет.

milestones.title: Локальный Bank — частичный MVP
milestones.scope: Сохранение файлов/URL/notes/objects без исследования; Bank/Collections/History, exact/full-text, local intake с видимыми ошибками.

milestones.title: Первый полный MVP
milestones.scope: Lens, Source/Policy, frozen RunSpec/Run/ResultSet/Occurrence, наблюдения и три end-to-end proof journeys.

milestones.title: Стабильный MVP
milestones.scope: Стабилизация принятого MVP: recovery, совместимость, backup/export/restore, ошибки и повторная полная приёмка. Новые TARGET-функции не обязательны.

milestones.title: Источники и качество исследования
milestones.scope: Typed relations, Routes, Recipes, Capability/Executor, evidence/claims, counter-search, verifier context, genealogy/retrieval provenance.

milestones.title: Идентичность и расширенный поиск
milestones.scope: Merge/split/corrections, semantic/graph/evidence-lineage/hybrid search, versioned textual representations и объяснимые профили.

milestones.title: Мультимодальность и доменные профили
milestones.scope: OCR/captions/hashes/media/domain-structural search, OPP-017 positive/negative examples, personal relevance и зрелые Domain Packs.

milestones.title: Watch и повторное наблюдение
milestones.scope: Saved Watch всех target scopes, ручной запуск и сохранённый intent/cadence. Unattended automation — отдельный COND-001 gate.
